title: Fix the Bug
description: Correct a broken template so the app compiles and displays properly.
problemStatement:
Your teammate accidentally broke the app! Open `app.component.html` and you'll find a typo. The page now shows an error and nothing renders. **The broken template:** ```html

Welcome to Progly

{{ user }} is learning Angular

The version is {{ version }}

``` The AppComponent class (`app.component.ts`) looks like this: ```typescript export class AppComponent { userName = 'Alex'; version = 17; } ``` Find and fix the bug so that the template correctly displays the user’s name and the version number. Then make sure the greeting text says 'Alex is learning Angular'.
hints: Look at the property name used in the template vs. the property defined in the class.
Interpolation binds to component properties – the name must match exactly.
expectedOutput: The browser displays 'Alex is learning Angular' and 'The version is 17' without any errors.
